name: DKCTF Hard Mode – real independent P2 selector
notes: Keeps the confirmed two-player Hard Mode foundation and forces the existing native Char_P2 reload at 0x352C74. The automatic DK/default pairing at 0x1E700C remains temporary and is overwritten from runtime data ID 0x66 before the transition continues.

entries.description: Preserve the +0x26AF multiplayer state during Hard Mode initialization.
Preserve the active P2 slot bit while the temporary automatic partner is initialized.
Do not skip the stock Char_P2 reload at 0x352C74. Force runtime data ID 0x66 to replace the temporary automatic DK/default partner.
